units.source_text: 当然，阿笑即使到了镇上，也是待在供大兵留宿的旅馆里。

en.t: Of course, even when Axiao went into town, she stayed at an inn where soldiers lodged.

units.source_text: 她那张白净的扁脸，像是迷迷瞪瞪地睡着了。

en.t: Her pale, flat face looked as if it had drifted drowsily off to sleep.

units.source_text: 她无忧无虑，并不觉得自己过着经常更换地方的生活。

en.t: She was carefree, and did not feel that she was living a life of constantly moving from place to place.

units.source_text: 只要有男人，她在哪儿都开心——她就这样安详地只顾往头发上抹油，似乎不曾想过要好好梳理它。

en.t: As long as there were men around, she was happy anywhere; with that same calm air, she only kept rubbing oil into her hair, as though it had never occurred to her to comb it properly.
